public interface IAssemblyService

GetTypes(string, Func<TypeInfo, bool>, Assembly)

Gets types from cache. If a filter is provided the cache can be populated on the first call, otherwise LoadTypes has to be called first to prepare the cache.

TypeInfo[] GetTypes(string cacheKey, Func<TypeInfo, bool> filter = null, Assembly baseAssembly = null)

Parameters

cacheKey string

Unique key for the specific cache.

filter Func<TypeInfo, bool>

Filter the types that should be loaded.

baseAssembly Assembly

Assembly to be used as entry point to look for types.

Returns

TypeInfo[]

LoadTypes(string, Func<TypeInfo, bool>, IEnumerable<Assembly>, Assembly)

Loads types into the cache. Then the types can be fetched using the GetServiceTypePairs (without a filter). See 'GetAssemblies' in 'AssemblyService' for default behaviour.

void LoadTypes(string cacheKey, Func<TypeInfo, bool> filter, IEnumerable<Assembly> assemblies = null, Assembly baseAssembly = null)
